what_this_is: The Workshop row that signs the Mac app's update record text with the release key held under mac-app-update-signing-key, through the engine's held-values:sign operation. The key never leaves the vault; the run's own capability is the only credential, and the row's right names that one key and that one operation.

payload.label: Sign a Mac app update record
payload.job: Sign the Mac app's update record text with the release key in my vault, so installed apps accept the update
payload.description: Signs the UTF-8 text it is given (the update record's signed lines) with the Ed25519 key held under mac-app-update-signing-key, through the engine's held-values:sign operation. The key never leaves the vault; the answer is the signature in base64, as the app reads it. Only a run reaches the operation; the run's right names that one key and that one operation.
The signed lines of the update record, joined by newlines.

provenance.source: New: the held-values:sign operation (trillion-rust src/secrets.rs, 24a83bb98), the one way the Mac app's update record is signed without reading the key out of the vault.
